assessment: Monstera deliciosa is displaying light stress: pale, washed-out leaves with loss of fenestration development in new growth (indicates too little light) or brown scorched patches on leaf surfaces (indicates too much direct sun). Current placement needs adjustment.

actions.action: Move the plant to a location with bright indirect light — near an east-facing window or 3–5 feet from a south-facing window with a sheer curtain.
actions.label: Relocate plant

actions.action: Inspect for scorched patches — if present, trim damaged leaves and avoid any direct afternoon sun exposure.
actions.label: Check for burns
